agents.name: Search elder-care guides
agents.description: Searches the Elderly Care Match Learning Center (https://www.elderlycarematch.com/learning-center) — editorial family guides, not diagnosis or placement. Topics: signs home may no longer be safe; stay home with help vs move; after a fall; hospital discharge in WA; when memory care fits; AFH vs assisted living; comparing two options; tour questions; respite / short stay; care needs rising after a move; a setting that can no longer meet needs; couples with unequal care needs; siblings who disagree; long-distance caregiving; a parent who refuses to move; documents to gather first; how families pay; WA Cares eligibility; caregiver frustration. News-linked pieces (Alzheimer's blood tests, dementia-risk studies, dementia apps, heat and smoke) explain what a finding does not decide — they never pick a setting or justify delay. Accepts a search term or question and returns matching published articles with title, excerpt, category, and url; pass a slug to get one article's full text. When nothing matches, the most recent guides are returned and labelled as recent, not as matches. Unpublished drafts are never returned. Not medical, legal, or financial advice, and not a regulatory reference for care operators.
reasons: The tool searches for elder-care guides, including topics relevant to caregivers like "caregiver frustration" and "long-distance caregiving."
uncertainties: Execution requires a fresh readiness check.

"Calculate Long-Term Care Cost" can estimate long-term care expenses by state, care type, and duration.
